name: Cyberspace Conspiracy
source:
After saving up money from her dead end office job, Beatrice finally has enough money to afford the latest piece of tech: The Dreamwave.

There are rumours all over the net that the Dreamwave uploads the user's soul to the internet, manifesting as a physical world that personifies the computer itself. Beatrice, with desperation clouding her mind,  dives head first into an unknown world and finds herself caught in a... Cyberspace Conspiracy!?

[From [url=https://starsauce.itch.io/cyberspace-conspiracy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在从没有出路的办公室工作中攒够钱后，比阿特丽斯终于有足够的钱购买最新的科技产品：Dreamwave。

网络上有传言称Dreamwave将用户的灵魂上传到互联网上，表现为计算机本身拟人化的物理世界。贝阿特丽斯怀着绝望的心情，一头扎进了一个未知的世界，却发现自己陷入了……网络空间阴谋！？

[来自[url=https://starsauce.itch.io/cyberspace-conspiracy]itch.io[/url]]
